title: Flight price tracker
description: Two row types share one dataset: fare (one per route and departure day — that day's cheapest itinerary) and status (one per route; never charged).

origin.description: Origin airport code on the itinerary.

destination.description: Destination airport code on the itinerary.

depart_date.description: Departure day, YYYY-MM-DD. On status rows: the first day of the window.

return_date.description: Return day for round trips, null for one-way.

seat.description: Cabin priced: economy, premium_economy, business or first.

currency.description: Currency of the price (ISO code), as Google actually priced it.

price.description: The day's cheapest fare for all passengers. For round trips this is the total for both legs.

price_display.description: Price exactly as Google states it, e.g. "127 US dollars".

round_trip_total.description: True when the price covers both legs of a round trip.

airline.description: Operating airline of the cheapest itinerary; the first when several operate it.

airlines.description: Every airline operating the cheapest itinerary.

stops.description: Stops on the cheapest itinerary; 0 is nonstop.

depart_time.description: Departure time, local to the origin.

arrive_time.description: Arrival time, local to the destination.

depart_day.description: Departure day as Google states it.

arrive_day.description: Arrival day as Google states it — later than the departure day on overnight itineraries.

duration.description: Total travel time as Google states it, e.g. "2 hr 55 min".

duration_minutes.description: Total travel time in minutes — the sortable form.

layovers.description: Each layover: index, of, minutes, airport, city. Null on nonstop itineraries.

overnight_layover.description: True when Google flags an overnight layover.

co2_kg.description: Google's carbon estimate for the itinerary, in kilograms.

google_url.description: The Google Flights URL for that day's search — opens the same results.

itineraries_seen.description: How many itineraries Google listed for that day; the fare row is the cheapest of them.

cheapest_in_window.description: True on the one day of the route's window with the lowest fare — the cheapest day to fly.

rank_in_window.description: 1 = the cheapest day of the window, 2 = the next, and so on. Ranked over every day searched, before the maxPrice filter.

days_searched.description: Status rows: departure days searched for this route.

fares.description: Status rows: fare rows delivered (and billed) for this route.

filtered.description: Status rows: days dropped by maxPrice — never billed.

no_results.description: Status rows: days on which Google listed no itinerary.

errors.description: Status rows: days whose search failed.

cheapest.description: Status rows: the lowest fare found across the window.

cheapest_date.description: Status rows: the day that lowest fare departs.

status.description: Status rows: ok, no_results or error.

error.description: Status rows: the first failure message, null when every day succeeded.

fetched_at.description: UTC timestamp when the row was fetched.
